name: bot_circle
about: A simple bot: walks a wide square around the arena (the weapons fire on their own), picks a perk at random whenever a level-up offers one, and plays until it dies or five minutes pass, checking that level-ups were offered and answered. Run it over seeds for averages: tools/play-script.ps1 Tests/Scripts/bot_circle.json -Seeds 1,2,3,4,5 -FixedStep 60 -Quiet
